## 变更 / Change

说明解决的问题和最终行为。Describe the problem and final behavior.

## 验证 / Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] 已检查受影响的浏览器流程 / Affected browser workflows were checked

## 范围 / Scope

- [ ] 未加入客户数据、敏感资料或无权分发的素材 / No customer data, sensitive data, or unauthorized assets are included
- [ ] 新增依赖及许可已写入第三方声明 / New dependencies and licenses are recorded in the third-party notices
- [ ] 中英文用户文档已同步（如适用）/ Chinese and English user documentation is synchronized when applicable
